{{Top|leg}}
'''K'Ji'Kur''' ('''"beholding"''') was a [[Gorothite/Legends|Gorothite]] tradition similar to the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Life debt/Legends|life debt]]. A Gorothite who helped another Gorothite in a significant way could declare that they were in their debt. The K'Ji'Kur was a one-time debt to be repaid at the first opportunity.
